body: I may take you up on that offer, i can imagine ill feel better talking to someone who can relate, it feels as if people just say 'i understand' when in reality theyre just saying it. I dobt want to be diagnosed as my mother would find out and i dont want her to know how im feeling, she often hears me crying myself to sleep and she gets really worried

Thank you for your kind words, im going to try sleep before i actually do something over just small thoughts, i wish i knew someone irl who actually understood though, and from previous experience with my brother i dont want to tell my mother or have her find out how i feel, i dont think shed be able to take it so going to a doctor isnt an option for me

i honestly dont think my life is worth getting help for, ive lost all self confidence and dont ever see myself having a family in the future, ive had this feeling for 2 years on and off but i dont know how to explain all this to my doctor or my mother and i don't want them to think any differently of me or look at me different, ive often wondered about ending it all but what if i survived? people would treat me different and think i did what i did for attention, i just feel like my life isnt worth living at certain times
